description: The line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny," illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for five different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, while the y-axis represents the WER, which ranges from 30 to 70. Each line corresponds to a specific configuration, as indicated by the legend: 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' (solid grey line with circle markers), 'tiny' (solid grey line with square markers), 'tiny int4' (dashed grey line with circle markers), 'tiny int8' (dashed grey line with square markers), and 'tiny full' (dotted grey line with triangle markers). The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' configuration starts with the highest WER at approximately 69 at epoch 0 and shows a steep decline, ending at about 40 at epoch 6. The 'tiny' configuration follows a similar trend, starting at around 60 and decreasing to approximately 32. The 'tiny int4' and 'tiny int8' configurations begin at WERs of about 55 and 59, respectively, and both show a gradual decline, converging to WERs of approximately 37 and 36 by epoch 6. The 'tiny full' configuration consistently maintains the lowest WER throughout, starting at around 29 and decreasing to about 23 by epoch 6.
